# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **m155 platform readiness**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 advances the m155 line while restoring Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments. The unreleased build also updates the Tizen packaging toolchain for current Tizen 10 targets.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **m155 core integration updated** — Integrates the current m155 core fork cleanup into the SkiaSharp line. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies system-font discovery restored** — Linux applications using the NoDependencies packages can again discover fonts installed on the system. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Tizen 10 builds and packaging updated** — Tizen packaging now builds with the GCC 14.2 toolchain required for Tizen 10 targets. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
